# Data

Fill this in as the data gets built (Hareem owns this file).

## Files
* `sample/sample_queries.csv` and `sample/sample_lid.json`: tiny demo data only.
* `raw/queries.csv`: the real dataset (kept on Google Drive).
* `raw/lid_annotated.json`: human corrected token labels.
* `processed/`: generated by `python -m src.dataset`.

## Intent csv schema
| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| id | unique id |
| text | the query |
| intent | one of assignment, exam, attendance, course_withdrawal, registration, fee, tech_support, grades, schedule, other |
| source | `human_real` (collected from students, test eligible), `human_seed` (written by us), `llm` (drafted by an LLM and reviewed) |
| lang_type | optional human label: english, roman_urdu, urdu_script, code_switched. If missing, a heuristic fills it. |

## LID json schema
`[{"id": "1", "tokens": ["Mujhe", "assignment", "submit"], "labels": ["UR", "EN", "EN"]}]`
Labels: EN, UR, NUM, OTHER. Tokenization comes from `src/preprocessing.py`, so annotate with the export helper.
